analysis: Price has pushed above VAH at $84,100, but the move is overwhelmingly driven by perpetual leverage rather than aggressive spot absorption. key_risk: Failure of spot CVD to follow through above VAH ($84,100), exposing overleveraged perps to a cascade back toward the POC ($84,000).
